usage: 翡翠蝦餃 is used to describe a type of dim sum that is commonly served in Cantonese restaurants.
You can use 翡翠蝦餃 to talk about food when ordering in a dim sum setting.
翡翠蝦餃 is countable; you can say 'one 翡翠蝦餃' or 'two 翡翠蝦餃'.
It's common to mention 翡翠蝦餃 when recommending popular dim sum dishes.
In conversation, you might ask if someone likes 翡翠蝦餃 to know their preference in dim sum.
